verdicts.reason: Both share serious flaws: the 'MAYA R., VERIFIED BUYER' attribution is set larger and heavier than the quote, which inverts the hierarchy and crowds the line right under it; the blush circle is cut off and stranded in the bottom-right corner instead of sitting behind the bottle; and the quote mark floats with a large gap above the headline. A at least gives the logo its own top band. In B the logo drops down level with the quote mark, so the two crowd each other off-axis and leave an empty strip at the top.
